title: Easy Pack Switcher
description: A small Fabric client mod that lets you bind hotkeys to toggle groups of resource packs on and off without opening the resource pack menu.
body:
**PackSwitch**
Bind hotkeys to toggle groups of resource packs instantly — no more digging through menus.
**Features**

Create named slots, each with a keybind and a list of resource packs
Press a key in-game to enable or disable that slot's packs with a full reload
Manage everything from an in-game config screen (ModMenu supported)
Edits to the config file outside the game are picked up automatically

**Usage**
Open the config screen via ModMenu, create a slot, assign a key, and add the pack folder/zip names you want it to toggle. That's it.
